pr_comments:
When the Settings UI is added, there could be an about section there, with a change log and version information.

Rather than spawning different dialogs for About, What's new, and Settings - keep it contained in a settings dialog, which has sections for the various settings...

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/7389110/59385162-a87fd100-8d5b-11e9-867b-a7899d5518bf.png)
Yes, we're not going to just keep adding things to the menu once we have some auxiliary UI support. Thanks!

issue_context.title: Feature Request: make the version number visible somewhere in the UI (menu maybe?)
comments: The settings window would make the most sense for this, once they add a GUI for editing profiles and colours etc
Well, once _we_ add a GUI for editing profiles. For the 0.2 milestone, it'll probably live in the menu and be generally inert.

_[DHowett-MSFT: Moved design image to consolidate design discussion.]_

I think putting it in settings (and not in an about dialog) would make a lot of sense

@mdtauk we are in agreement, but we probably aren’t getting a whole settings UI in the next two weeks. I’ve seen this design in a number of places; would it help for us to have a consolidated design discussion thread instead of using every issue as one?

> @mdtauk we are in agreement, but we probably aren’t getting a whole settings UI in the next two weeks. I’ve seen this design in a number of places; would it help for us to have a consolidated design discussion thread instead of using every issue as one?

Ah ok, so if its needed for an initial store release, you could put it in the flyout with the profiles listed?
Yep! I know it’s less than ideal :)
I'm gonna suggest `wt --version`? The new tab flyout could get very busy very fast.

_[DHowett-MSFT: Moved design image to consolidate design discussion.]_ 
Change logs and Version numbers should be contained within a settings dialog
Just to set some context, we're talking about _0.2_ here, not _1.0_
